A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A-G. The shorter v5 removes the NeurIPS checklist while retaining all scientific sections and appendices.

before.justification: v4 reports original reconstruction, generation, downsampling and inversion results in Section 4, plus original ablations and generalization experiments in Appendix D.

after.justification: v5 retains original IP-Encoder and IP-VAE experimental results, including the additional multiclass, partial-view and out-of-distribution experiments in Appendix D.

M1.justification: The IPT/dIPT definitions, IP-Encoder, IP-VAE, combined CD/IPT loss, downsampler and optimization-based inversion procedure are unchanged in Sections 3-4 and Appendix F.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ShapeNet classes, ShapeNet13, MNIST and GenRe partial views. Reconstruction, generation, downsampling, interpolation, cross-class reconstruction and rotation scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: PointFlow, SoftFlow, ShapeGF, Canonical VAE and LION remain the Table 1 comparators. Comparator membership also matches in the generation, timing, downsampling, partial-view and multiclass comparisons in Tables 3-5, S.2 and S.6.

E3.justification: The stated preprocessing, point counts, IPT resolutions, training budgets, metrics and scaling factors are unchanged. Section 4.4 retains the same inversion optimizer and learning-rate schedule; Appendix D retains its experimental settings.

E4.justification: The loss, resolution, scale, direction-count and cardinality ablations remain unchanged, as do the generalization tests and supplementary examples. The experimental additions described in Appendix A's changelog already appear in v4.

E5.justification: Removing checklist item 7 deletes the explanation that error bars are provided where applicable and omitted where uncommon in the literature. The actual uncertainty entries in Tables 1, 6 and S.1 remain identical; no change in runs or seeds is documented.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1-6 and S.1-S.6, timings and qualitative findings are retained. For example, Table S.2 keeps IP-Encoder chair CD/EMD at 1.10/1.24 and car CD/EMD at 0.71/0.91 under the same settings.

T1.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendix G retain the same definitions, assumptions, injectivity theorem, metric and additivity lemmas, surjectivity theorem and proofs. Appendix changes are confined to pagination.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions and Section 5 retain the same claims about computational efficiency, expressivity, reconstruction and generation quality, interpolation and generalization without retraining.

C2.justification: The substantive limitations and interpretations remain unchanged, including limited generative diversity, imperfect cross-class generalization, direction-selection and rotation issues, and scalability limitations. The deleted checklist's limitations answer merely points to the retained discussion.

D1.justification: Checklist removal drops the explicit statement that pretrained models and scraped data are not provided. The code URL, BSD-3-Clause license, hardware, training times and architectural details remain unchanged. This is a disclosure removal; actual resource availability is not shown to change.

R1.justification: All 44 cited works and the research-positioning discussion are retained. Reference 34 changes from a 2025 arXiv entry to publication details for the same work in Artificial Intelligence in Biomedicine (2026), which is a bibliographic update.

P1.justification: v5 removes the standalone NeurIPS Paper Checklist, changes Bastian Rieck's affiliation markers and updates one bibliography entry. The scientific narrative, section order and appendix wording otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The title is rewrapped and the bibliography reflows, moving reference 41 to the next page. Checklist removal brings the appendices forward. Scientific figures, tables, captions and their internal layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The methods, evidence, proofs and substantive limitations are identical. Removing administrative material and updating metadata provide modest editorial cleanup, accompanied by limited loss of checklist disclosures about error bars and supplied assets. These changes leave the paper's scientific support and practical reproducibility substantially intact, with no meaningful net quality difference.
